description: The Cuemon.Extensions.AspNetCore.Text.Json namespace contains both types and extension methods that complements both the Cuemon.Extensions.AspNetCore/Cuemon.Extensions.Text.Json namespace while being an addition to the Microsoft.AspNetCore namespace. Extends upon JSON formatters and converters in the context of ASP.NET Core for System.Text.Json.
